mapper.sql:
event_id AS eventId, title, category, description, DATE_FORMAT(start_at, '%Y%m%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(end_at, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS endDateExclusive,
(TIME(start_at) = '00:00:00' AND TIME(end_at) = '00:00:00') AS allDay, DATE_FORMAT(start_at, '%Y%m%dT%H%i%s') AS startDateTime, DATE_FORMAT(end_at, '%Y%m%dT%H%i%s') AS endDateTime, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(start_at, '+09:00', '+00:00'), '%Y%m%dT%H%i%sZ') AS startUtc, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(end_at, '+09:00', '+00:00'), '%Y%m%dT%H%i%sZ') AS endUtc, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(updated_at, '+09:00', '+00:00'), '%Y%m%dT%H%i%sZ') AS dtstamp
mapper.select: SELECT FROM events WHERE state = 'normal' ORDER BY start_at ASC, event_id ASC
SELECT FROM events WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND state = 'normal'

SELECT event_id AS eventId, title, category, description, DATE_FORMAT(start_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(end_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate,
CASE WHEN TIME(start_at) = '00:00:00' AND TIME(end_at) = '00:00:00' THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT(start_at, '%H:%i') END AS startTime, CASE WHEN TIME(start_at) = '00:00:00' AND TIME(end_at) = '00:00:00' THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT(end_at, '%H:%i') END AS endTime FROM events WHERE state = 'normal' AND start_at <= #{to} AND end_at >= #{from} ORDER BY start_at ASC

SELECT event_id AS eventId, title, category, description, DATE_FORMAT(start_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(end_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate,
CASE WHEN TIME(start_at) = '00:00:00' AND TIME(end_at) = '00:00:00' THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT(start_at, '%H:%i') END AS startTime, CASE WHEN TIME(start_at) = '00:00:00' AND TIME(end_at) = '00:00:00' THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT(end_at, '%H:%i') END AS endTime FROM events WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND state = 'normal'
SELECT event_category_id AS eventCategoryId, name FROM event_categories WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY display_order ASC, event_category_id ASC

SELECT image_id AS imageId, event_id AS eventId, file_url AS fileUrl, file_name AS fileName, file_type AS fileType, file_size AS fileSize, state FROM event_images WHERE state = 'normal' AND event_id IN #{id} ORDER BY event_id ASC, sort_order ASC, image_id ASC

SELECT i.image_id AS imageId, i.event_id AS eventId, i.file_url AS fileUrl, i.file_name AS fileName, i.file_type AS fileType, i.file_size AS fileSize, i.state, e.state AS eventState FROM event_images i JOIN events e ON e.event_id = i.event_id WHERE i.image_id = #{imageId}
